rules.meaning: Only ACCEPTED exact-content factors may contribute semantic tags.
Gate Base + Line Modifier + Driver Role + Layer Role contribute by explicit admitted tag membership; composition is set union plus governed tag rules.
Tag rules may match only explicit admitted tags and declared conditions.
A SOURCE_GAP factor remains a visible gap. It must never be silently replaced by conventional astrology, Human Design, Gene Keys, or model-generated semantics.
Multiple owner surfaces are allowed through primaryOwner + secondaryOwners[].
Equal priority among otherwise eligible outputs resolves to UNKNOWN.
Missing required semantic tag resolves to UNKNOWN for the dependent composition/card/topic.
Customer wording must come from admitted customer meaning refs; raw source wording and source-brand identity are not automatically public.
Human acceptance is exact-content bound. Any semantic content change invalidates the prior ACCEPT.
Current Reality remains OBSERVATION + COMPARISON only in V4.1.
